findings.finding: U+FFFD is not always fail-closed: public parse() exposes strict_text=False and then accepts replacement text. Dispatch uses the safe default, but a caller can bypass the required guard directly.
findings.reproduction: With the pinned PDF/pages, replace 'Teodoro' by 'Te�odoro' and call parse(..., strict_text=False); it returned supported fields (accepted_strict_false).
findings.required_fix: Remove the bypass or make strict_text a non-overridable production constant; add a regression proving direct parse and dispatch both reject U+FFFD.

findings.finding: The parser pins SHA and the receipt records 348300 bytes, but parse has no explicit expected byte-length constant/check.
findings.required_fix: Pin and assert the receipt byte length alongside SHA before integration.
